object:spherical / amulet of life saving.visualDescription: A long golden neck loop holds a spherical dark blue-gray pendant with a white crosslike sparkle.
object:spherical / amulet of life saving.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of life saving prevents one fatal outcome and is then consumed. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:spherical / amulet of life saving.modelBrief: Build a round blue-gray pendant on a long gold cord, with a single white glint rather than a literal medical emblem. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Amulet of life saving

object:oval / amulet of strangulation.visualDescription: An oval slate pendant hangs from a broad gold loop, with a pale vertical oval highlight.
object:oval / amulet of strangulation.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of strangulation tightens around the wearer and can kill if not removed. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:oval / amulet of strangulation.modelBrief: Make a dark oval pendant on the standard gold cord; represent strangulation through gameplay, not a visibly closed noose. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:triangular / amulet of restful sl.visualDescription: A dark triangular pendant hangs point-down from the same long gold neck loop.
object:triangular / amulet of restful sl.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of restful sleep periodically makes its wearer fall asleep. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:triangular / amulet of restful sl.modelBrief: Build a simple charcoal triangular medallion and gold cord with no sleep icon. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Amulet of restful sleep

object:pyramidal / amulet versus poison.visualDescription: A narrow dark pyramid-like pendant points downward from a gold neck loop.
object:pyramidal / amulet versus poison.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet versus poison grants poison resistance. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:pyramidal / amulet versus poison.modelBrief: Make a pointed gray pyramidal charm on the common gold cord; keep the protection effect separate. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:square / amulet of change.visualDescription: A gray square pendant is turned like a diamond beneath a long gold necklace loop.
object:square / amulet of change.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of change changes the wearer's sex when put on. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:square / amulet of change.modelBrief: Build a small four-cornered stone or metal medallion with dark edge and gold cord; keep transformation out of the mesh. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:concave / amulet of unchanging.visualDescription: A dark round concave pendant has a recessed pale center and hangs from a gold cord.
object:concave / amulet of unchanging.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of unchanging prevents form changes while worn. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:concave / amulet of unchanging.modelBrief: Create a shallow inward-bowled circular pendant with gray center and dark rim, suspended from the standard necklace. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:hexagonal / amulet of reflection.visualDescription: A gray six-sided pendant with pale upper facets hangs below a gold neck loop.
object:hexagonal / amulet of reflection.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of reflection turns back ray and gaze attacks. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:hexagonal / amulet of reflection.modelBrief: Build a faceted hexagonal gray medallion with restrained pale highlights; avoid painting incoming rays on it. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:octagonal / amulet of magical bre.visualDescription: A broad pale gray octagonal charm with dark lower facets hangs from a long gold necklace.
object:octagonal / amulet of magical bre.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of magical breathing lets its wearer breathe underwater and survive without air. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:octagonal / amulet of magical bre.modelBrief: Make a chunky eight-sided stone pendant with a simple gold cord, without bubbles fixed to the asset. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Amulet of magical breathing

object:perforated / amulet of guarding.visualDescription: A dark gray perforated charm is a small ring with a visible hole, suspended from gold cord.
object:perforated / amulet of guarding.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of guarding improves intrinsic protection. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:perforated / amulet of guarding.modelBrief: Model an open-centered dark medallion with thick rim; leave armor bonuses to item data. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:cubical / amulet of flying.visualDescription: A pale gray cube-shaped pendant with dark bottom facets hangs from the standard gold neck loop.
object:cubical / amulet of flying.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of flying grants flight while worn. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:cubical / amulet of flying.modelBrief: Make a small faceted cubic pendant with gold cord, keeping it as a worn item rather than a floating object. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.wikiTitle: Cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor
object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.visualDescription: A dull gold circular amulet carries a bright red center and hangs from a tan neck cord.
object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies this as a plastic imitation of the real Amulet of Yendor, sharing its apparent name until identified.
object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.modelBrief: Build a slightly dull, cheaper-looking round gold-colored frame with simple red inset; preserve its similarity to the real amulet.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor

object:Amulet of Yendor / Amulet of Yend.visualDescription: A richer round golden amulet has a deep crimson center, bright gold rim, and a long pale-gold cord.
object:Amulet of Yendor / Amulet of Yend.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the genuine Amulet of Yendor as the unique mithril quest artifact.
object:Amulet of Yendor / Amulet of Yend.modelBrief: Make an ornate yet compact gold-toned frame with a dark ruby-red center and bright rim; it should read close to, but finer than, the imitation.
